notes.title: Beta 3 Pre Release 2
notes.content:
[p]Sorry for this update taking a long time, been doing a lot of stuff that has stopped me from spending time working on it, at the same time had to basically rework the load in system and expand on file data for countries and more, should be near the end of the update cycle now though.

the size of the internal changes has made me re consider this as a minor update and bumped it up to beta 3, since i apparently can't do minor updates anymore, they just automatically become huge from nowhere

this devlog might change in the future to be more specific due to lack of time to look back at old notes and the game itself[/p][p]many changes as most likely been left out.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]New load in system that supports both internal map load in and file map load in[/p][/*][*][p]main menu is now back and accessible[/p][/*][*][p]entity name and entity data (such as country) is now divided in their own files so that language files only need to include the name and no data[/p][/*][*][p]entity data files now include "data colour, base colour, border colour"[/p][/*][*][p]continents and subcontinents also include "internal on off switch name"[/p][/*][*][p]subcontinents also include their respective continents "internal on off switch name"[/p][/*][*][p]countries data file now includes colour timers, current colours, funding status, strength and much more that i honestly don't remember right now and don't got time to look up[/p][/*][*][p]Notification text now supports multiple colours and font sizes[/p][/*][*][p]Notifications are now saved to daily lists instead of immediately added to the text and then are added all at once each day in specific order and only 1 date text above for the day[/p][/*][*][p]country names are now always black in notifications[/p][/*][*][p]war notifications are now in red[/p][/*][*][p]peaceful notifications are now in green[/p][/*][*][p]unknown status yet notifications are now in yellow[/p][/*][*][p]flood notifications are now in gray[/p][/*][*][p]terraforming notifications are now in brown[/p][/*][*][p]funding notifications are now gray and smaller[/p][/*][*][p]funding notifications related to countries at war and donation notifications are now whiter gray and less smaller[/p][/*][*][p]date text is now bigger, white and underlined[/p][/*][*][p]added hidden command menu[/p][/*][*][p]added 3 main commands (not accessible in current version due to me having issues with the open menu button not working)[/p][olist][*][p]Event[/p][p]Has Following Subevents
1.Divide
2.AnnexVote
3.WarVote
4.Rebellion
each one needs to be followed by 1 or 2 country names with rebellion needing 1 culture name[/p][/*][*][p]Strength
Followed by country name and then strength number or "Locked" to lock the strength or "UnLocked" to unlock it[/p][/*][*][p]Funding
has following sub commands
Fund
DeFund
RanOut
ScrapingBarrel
each one needs to be followed by 1 country names
[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p]More commands are half done such as "Sink, No Peace, change name, invincible, Event Peace, Terrain Events" and more[/p][/*][*][p]Updated strength system to be more fun gameplay wise[/p][/*][*][p]Updated strength system to make countries run out of resources easier and if they got 0 of their own culture left[/p][/*][*][p]buffed naval invasion ranges[/p][/*][*][p]in divide event random countries are added in naval invasions to give them a chance to join the war[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a bunch of bugs, specially related to the new subcontinent toggles but got a lot to do so can't document it all atm[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Beta 2
notes.content:
[h2]Events[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed drain events having 0% chance of happening
[*] Fixed big flood having low chance of happening
[*] Set small flood odds back to 0% (was taken out a long time ago due to bugs but accidentally got it's odds back in beta 1)
[*] Slightly changed back all other event odds that got changed by the mistake
[*] Countries joining a war now actually makes the victim country weaker
[*] Naval invasions speed is now based on map size instead of constant
[*] Fixed issues related to the invasion side advantage calculations
[*] Fixed 1 spot making naval protection 200% instead of 20%
[*] added culture civilwar independence event (Will be redone to be based on cities aswell as more civil war events added later once the city map is done)
[*] Added civilwar funding sub event based on event side odds and origin country size
[*] Changed annex event pixel order to random
[*] Made a randomized chance of peace deal each day that's more rare then normal peace deal but without side advantage limitations
[*] Peace treaties no longer consider lake shores as valid areas to keep
[*] Added code that makes a specified country invincible (not anyway to assign it to a country atm)
[*] Naval Invasion range now depends on how many months into the war it is
[*] Naval Invasion range now increase each failed attempt with it resetting after a success
[*] Naval Invasions now do 1 calculation per subcontinent per country per water type (ocean & lake) (therefore if there is a 3v1 war with each country having both lake and ocean shore in 2 continents there’d be 8 calculations total)
[*] Naval invasions now use 2 data maps, one for each war side
[*] Increased min size for peace treaties to not remove a exclave
[/list]

[h2]Pixel Data Handling[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed bugs relating to miss matched data
[*] Turned on the former country data collection code
[*] Turned on the culture data collection code
[*] Turned on the city data collection code (is turned on but should do nothing for now as there is no cities in game yet)
[*] Reworked the data collection system for cultures and former countries to match the city data collection system (aka save borders and shorelines instead of just size number)
[*] New Subcontinent map (This should in theory increase lag but make country movement better, it's now based on actual geography instead of randomly generated)
[*] The game now fixes issues that can be caused by high ammounts of lags after sorting pixels
[*] Added diagonal movement
[*] Updated invasion pixel prioritization calculations to prioritize non diagonal pixels and more
[*] Increased the Max movement difficulty from 100 to max unity int value(this is meant to never be reached as it causes issues)
[*] New "connected to revolt map" now exists to decide what the revolts desired area is (press f12 to see the mapmode)
[*] Pixel calculations in war now has a total value instead of value per subcontinent, sub continents will now only do the same % of the total battle value as their % of the war border
[*] Annex events now use the same system to figure out how many pixels to calculate per day, but does the max possible number each day
[*] Fixed bug where the border status wasn't removed properly when "victim" side was gaining land
[*] Updated Invasion movement Values
[/list]

[h2]Visual Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Merged Edge colours on heightmap to allow greater contrast withing the more common middle colours on the height map
[*] so far unused faster load in option (once done it will turn off the visual part of the map load in in exchange for faster load in)
[*] Added lake shore paint colour
[*] lakeshore paint colour is now always a brighter version of base paint colour
[*] border paint colour is now seperated from base paint colour
[*] shore paint colour is now always a brighter version of border paint colour
[*] Countries now support more than 1 colour per colour type
[*] countries now switch between the colours within a country type every 14 days (less for smaller maps)
[*] Oceans are now darker coloured
[*] Lakes are now lighter coloured
[*] war borders is now painted with the "victim" countries border colourAdded following Pre set colour
[/list]

notes.title: Beta 2 Pre Release 3
notes.content:

The new events are mostly done but still unfinished and therefore toggled off for this pre release
[list]
[*] New Subcontinent map
[/list]
This should in theory increase lag but make country movement better
it's now based on actual geography instead of randomly generated

Changed 300 Vector2's to Vector2int to reduce memory usage on not used decimals and stop coordinates from slowly drifting

Fixed 1 spot making naval protection 200% instead of 20%
